description: B2B media and insights for registered investment adviser firms on firm formation, compliance, technology, and succession.
tagline: The operational blueprint for independent RIAs.
image_alt: Institute of RIA - B2B media for registered investment advisers.

authors.name: Institute of RIA Editorial
authors.bio: Our editorial team covers firm formation, compliance, technology stacks and succession for RIA principals, COOs, and compliance leads.

editorial.how_we_test: We publish reproducible, back-tested reviews of technology stacks and services using live RIA operational environments.
editorial.how_we_make_money: We generate revenue through vendor referrals and sponsorships from RIA-serving vendors. We do not provide investment advice and we do not match consumers with advisers.
editorial.corrections: Corrections to factual errors will be published prominently on the affected page within 24 hours of verification.
